_README: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every page title and description. sh/apply-meta.mjs writes these into the six head slots and into the structured data, so the same sentence is stored once instead of being typed into four places. {{courses}}, {{executives}}, {{execDays}}, {{hours}}, {{price}} and {{priceInHouse}} are filled from stats.json, which is why no figure here is written as a digit. Never type a title or description into a page: the next commit overwrites it and sh/check-stats.sh Part 8 blocks the push.
_FIELDS: title -> <title>, og:title, twitter:title. description -> <meta name=description> and the WebPage node in the structured data, which were always the same sentence. ogDescription -> og:description. twitterDescription -> twitter:description, omitted on pages that carry no twitter tags. schemaName -> the WebPage node name, stored only where it differs from title. schema -> extra structured-data strings that carry a figure, keyed by a stable anchor: node:<@id> or faq:<question>.
_PRICE: The JSON-LD Offer price is not stored here. It is always stats.price written as bare digits, with no R and no comma, because a grouped price is not valid schema.org. apply-meta writes it from stats.json directly.
